emma: Quick flag - bringing up MistralX-S/7B int4 on the bench and seeing a consistent quality drift on longcode-gen and long-summary tasks. Short prompts (<=128) look fine. Large contexts (>=2048) degrade.

jorge: can you share the eval deltas?

emma: pasted from bench run (seed 7):
```
# longcode-gen (2048)
pass@1: 0.27  # fp16 baseline 0.34
perplexity: 21.4  # fp16 16.0
# long-summary (4096)
ROUGE-L: 36.0  # fp16 40.2
```

priya: hmm looks like phase accumulation / head misalignment. Any converter flags changed?

emma: we used default converter but switched proj-pack to "pack-compact" for int4 size savings. runtime config uses kv_stride=256. converter metadata reports kv_stride=128 (ugh).

luke: mismatch between converter kv_stride and runtime read will permute memory layout across heads. Short sequences hide it because few cache hits. Long sequences amplify.

emma: i dumped head 6 key vectors for layer 12 across first 1024 tokens. cross-corr(fp16,int4) drops steadily with token index.

jorge: can you run a small repro: convert with explicit --kv-stride 256 and rerun a short 2048 job? if that recovers, root cause is layout.

emma: started a rerun. also trying disabling the "phasewalk" rotary normalization we added for fp16 to see if quant rounding interacts.

ci-bot: job 9921 queued: mistralx-int4-kvstride-check (triggered by emma)

bench-bot: allocated p3dn.24xlarge for 20m

priya: odd note: MistralX-S uses interleaved head groups (group size 2) in projector order. pack-compact assumed contiguous head order. So three layers of mismatch: proj-order, kv_stride, interleaved grouping.

luke: that combination could create a head-permutation that varies per-layer -> phase signals walk across heads as tokens accumulate ("phasewalk"). That would explain monotonic decay in cross-corr.

emma: the kv_stride=256 conversion run finished. quick results: perplexity -> 17.2, pass@1 -> 0.31, ROUGE-L -> 39.1. Better but still shy of fp16.

jorge: improvement proves layout is major factor. remaining gap probably proj-order vs interleaved packing. Try converter with --proj-order interleaved and --group-size 2.

emma: launching that now + a run with rotary-normalizer disabled.

ci-bot: job 9921 started: mistralx-int4-proj-interleaved-and-rotary-off

bench-bot: ETA 9m

priya: regardless of outcome we should: 1) require converter to emit explicit head-order + kv_stride metadata, 2) add converter smoke check that loads a tiny seed and compares cross-head diag similarity to fp16 (>0.96), 3) add a runtime guard that errors when metadata mismatch occurs.

luke: also add a small FFT-based phase-coherence check across the first N tokens to detect creeping phase drift early in CI. cheap to run.

emma: agreed. if the interleaved+rotary-off run converges to baseline i'll open a PR with converter metadata + diag check + CI FFT probe. will paste final numbers when job completes. thanks.

ci-bot: job 9921 completed: interleaved+rotary-off partial-pass. follow-up tests required.

bench-bot: deallocated p3dn.24xlarge
